When_a_HTTP_request_is_received.description: Call this once at the very start of a new agent session or conversation, before the first call to loop-budget-check, to clear any previous step count for this session_id. Do not call this mid-loop — it erases progress tracking and would let a runaway loop continue past its real step count. Only call it when you are certain this is the beginning of a new, distinct agent run.

session_id.description: A unique identifier for the new agent session or conversation. Use the same value on every subsequent loop-budget-check call for this run.

max_steps.description: The step budget to set for this new session. Optional — if omitted, defaults to 25.

Insert_or_Update_Entity.description: UNVERIFIED SHAPE — best-effort reconstruction of the Azure Tables built-in connector's 'Insert or Update Entity' action, not confirmed against a live deployment. If this shows an error after pasting, delete it and re-add 'Azure Tables -> Insert or Update Entity' via the designer: Table name = LoopBudgets, Partition key = session, Row key = triggerBody()?['session_id'], then set entity properties StepCount = 0, MaxSteps = coalesce(triggerBody()?['max_steps'], 25).
